scenes.title: He failed 5,126 times
scenes.say: He failed over five thousand times. Then he changed vacuums.

scenes.label: prototypes James Dyson built from 1979 to 1984
scenes.say: James Dyson built five thousand one hundred twenty seven prototypes in five years.

scenes.label: the first Dyson-brand vacuum, the DC01, goes on sale
scenes.say: No big company would make it. So in ninety three, he launched his own.

scenes.title: Every failure is a lesson.
scenes.say: Keep going. Follow for more founder stories.
